newsitem.title: ITALY: ALPINE SKIING-PROFILES OF WOMEN'S DOWNHILL WINNERS.
newsitem.headline: ALPINE SKIING-PROFILES OF WOMEN'S DOWNHILL WINNERS.

text.p: Profiles of the joint winners of a women's World Cup downhill on Friday:
Previous World Cup wins: 2 downhills - Lillehammer 1996, Bad Kleinkirchheim 1997.

Other facts: Sister of former men's Olympic and world champion Pirmin Zurbriggen. Had reputation as a second-placer before first World Cup win, with five seconds in the World Cup, a world championships silver in 1989 giant slalom and another silver in 1996 super-G. Considered retiring last season.
Previous World Cup wins: 2 downhills - Garmisch 1994, Cortina 1996.

Other facts: Double Olympic bronze medallist and reigning super-G world champion. Her first win at Garmisch was overshadowed by tragedy when Austria's Ulrike Maier died in a crash on the course. Her father is a woodcarver in Val Gardena and Kostner often helps him to paint the statues he makes.
